hero.subtitle: A student club at the University of Akli Mohand Oulhadj — Bouira, pushing the boundaries of electronics, robotics, and creative technology.

intro.title: Who We Are
intro.description: AFAQ is a student club where technology, electronics, creativity, innovation, and teamwork come together. We provide a space for students to learn, build, and grow through hands-on projects and collaborative events.

activities.title: Our Activities
activities.sub: From electronics to software, we cover the full spectrum of modern technology.

workshops.title: Workshops
workshops.desc: Hands-on learning sessions on Arduino, programming, electronics, and more.
workshops.details: Our workshops cover a wide range of topics from Arduino basics to advanced programming concepts. Each session is designed to be hands-on, allowing participants to build real projects and gain practical skills that complement their academic studies.

robotics.title: Robotics
robotics.desc: Design, build, and program robots for competitions and research.
robotics.details: The robotics program brings together students passionate about mechanical design, electronics, and programming. Teams collaborate to build robots for local and national competitions, learning project management and engineering principles along the way.

iot.title: IoT & Electronics
iot.details: Explore the world of connected devices through our IoT track. Members work with sensors, microcontrollers, and communication protocols to build smart systems that solve real-world problems, from home automation to environmental monitoring.

hackathons.title: Hackathons
hackathons.desc: Intense coding and innovation challenges to solve real problems.
hackathons.details: Our hackathons bring together students for intense coding sessions where teams build complete solutions in a limited time. These events foster creativity, rapid prototyping, and teamwork while addressing real-world challenges.

competitions.title: Competitions
competitions.desc: Friendly tech competitions to showcase skills and win prizes.
competitions.details: Regular competitions give members a platform to showcase their talents, from coding challenges to robotics battles. These friendly contests encourage healthy competition and skill development.

software.title: Software Dev
software.desc: Web, mobile, and systems programming projects with modern tools.
software.details: The software development track focuses on building real-world applications using modern frameworks and tools. Members work on web, mobile, and systems projects, learning version control, agile methodologies, and deployment practices.

training.title: Training
training.desc: Expert-led workshops and technical training sessions for all levels.
training.details: Our training program offers structured learning paths for members at all skill levels. Led by experienced mentors, these sessions cover topics like Python, web development, embedded systems, and AI.

upcomingEvents.noEvents: No upcoming events at the moment. Stay tuned!
